# The same bullet, naming the field that exists

Same block shape — a bullet opening with a backticked dotted token, a
backticked value mid-sentence, a continuation line. The value written
here is literally `"public"`, so a lexical rule aimed at the drift twin
would take this page with it.

- `expose.network`: set it to `"public"` and the operator renders an
  HTTPRoute on the platform Gateway.
